page_title: MON 1-3 LYO | Monaco v Lyon 03/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Caio Henrique (Monaco) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90+6' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lyon.
90+3' The substitution has been made. Martin Satriano (Lyon) has replaced Corentin Tolisso.
90+2' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Lyon are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
88' Adam Karabec (Lyon) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
86' Orel Mangala (Lyon) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
81' Paulo Fonseca has decided to substitute Abner Vinicius and he is replaced by Orel Mangala (Lyon).
81' Substitution. Pavel Sulc walks off the pitch and Adam Karabec (Lyon) comes on as a substitute.
79' 1 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Nicolas Tagliafico sprays a pass out to Abner Vinicius (Lyon), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:3.
78' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) is booked.
77' Sebastien Pocognoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stanis Idumbo (Monaco) replacing Aleksandr Golovin.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and George Ilenikhena (Monaco) comes onto the pitch for Mika Biereth.
74' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
70' Jerome Brisard shows a red card with no hesitation. Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) can have an early bath and think about his challenge.
70' Booking. Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) receives a caution from the referee.
70' The referee shows the yellow card to Ruben Kluivert (Lyon).
69' The game is interrupted now, Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

67' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Lukas Hradecky has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
66' Khalis Merah will be replaced by Tanner Tessmann (Lyon).
64' There's an opportunity for Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
63' Shots on target – 2:4.
57' 1 - 2 Pavel Sulc (Lyon) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
56' Lyon will take a corner kick.

54' The referee blows his whistle after Mika Biereth (Monaco) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. It's a free kick to Lyon, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
54' Celebrations are cut short for Monaco as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
53' Possible change! There could be a foul by the attacking team in the lead up. Referee Jerome Brisard wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
52' Sebastien Pocognoli appears to have said too much and referee Jerome Brisard comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
52' The Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Jerome Brisard rules it out for a foul.
51' The referee awards a corner and Caio Henrique (Monaco) goes over to take it.
51' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee blows his whistle, Monaco are awarded a corner kick.
51' Jordan Teze (Monaco) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
48' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes.
46' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+9' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+8' The Monaco players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
45+6' Clinton Mata (Lyon) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+4' 1 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper.
45+2' PENALTY APPEAL after Afonso Moreira (Lyon) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.
44' The linesman makes the right call and Monaco will have a corner.
38' 0 - 1 Pavel Sulc (Lyon) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
38' The referee signals a corner kick to Lyon.
36' Sebastien Pocognoli is forced to make a change. Christian Mawissa is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco).
35' Clinton Mata (Lyon) gets a yellow card.
29' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Lukas Hradecky anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
28' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
28' The ball possession is 55:45.

25' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Monaco are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
22' Tyler Morton (Lyon) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
21' Lyon will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
20' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle and it's Folarin Balogun (Monaco) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Lyon will take a free kick near the side line.
19' Corner kick. Monaco will have an opportunity.
19' Caio Henrique (Monaco) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Monaco.
18' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) makes a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul. Monaco are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
16' The ball goes out of play and Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.

16' Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, Dominik Greif shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity! The ball is out of play. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner.
15' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) prepares to take a corner kick.

15' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Problems for Sebastien Pocognoli as Lukas Hradecky is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Philipp Kohn (Monaco) replaces him.
10' Lukas Hradecky (Monaco) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
9' Lukas Hradecky (Monaco) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
7' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) has tested the patience of referee Jerome Brisard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
7' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Lyon are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
7' Monaco try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
7' Tyler Morton (Lyon) commits a rough foul. Jerome Brisard stops the game and makes a call. That's a free kick to Monaco.

5' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the top right corner. Dominik Greif has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
2' Lukas Hradecky (Monaco) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
1' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
1' The first half has started.
Lyon will kick the game off.
